purpose: Keep the ongoing45-fit comparison and any eventual claim aligned with current generative-cell literature; do not interpret a win over selected baselines as exhaustive SOTA.

primary_sources.directly_verified: A conditional model combining latent flow matching with discrete single-cell count generation; supports multiple attributes/modalities.
primary_sources.our_inference: Appropriate count-generation comparator for the declared stage-conditioned ALZ task. Its published dataset/metric results are not ALZ energy-distance targets.

primary_sources.directly_verified: Transformer-based VAE and latent diffusion model with multiple conditioning variables; evaluates observational and perturbational expression generation and compares with scVI/CFGen.
primary_sources.our_inference: Relevant additional comparator to screen before any broad field-level SOTA claim. No ALZ adapter or matched result has been measured here.

primary_sources.directly_verified: Models count-valued samples using local birth/death rates. Includes RNA marginal generation/transport; its conditional-generation demonstrations concern neural spike counts.
primary_sources.our_inference: Potential count-space comparator; applicability and an exact RNA stage-conditioning recipe still need review. No matched ALZ result is available.

primary_sources.directly_verified: Documents incompatible evaluation spaces and metric settings across gene-expression generative papers and supports explicit distributional metric configuration.
primary_sources.our_inference: Published Wasserstein/MMD values cannot be numerically compared with this project energy distance without matching data, normalization, feature space and estimand.

limited_access.status: Browser verification prevented direct full-paper inspection; excluded from substantive evidence in this audit.

claim_logic.even_if_PG_ranks_first_in45: At most best among the tested methods under the declared historically exposed ALZ protocol, with uncertainty and unequal tuning budgets disclosed. Broad SOTA remains unproven.
